responsibility: Implements the gm2 front-end pipeline that takes pass-3 quadruples through optimization and into GCC trees. It coordinates unreachable-procedure elimination, constant and branch folding, basic-block cleanup, SSA-style temporary discovery, scope-block formation, symbol declaration via `M2GCCDeclare`, per-scope quad-to-tree translation via `M2GenGCC`, whole-program/module traversal, SWIG/debug side outputs, and compile-time optimization statistics.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the operational implementation of M2Code: it coordinates quad optimization, basic-block and scope processing, declaration, tree conversion, and whole-program traversal, in contrast to `M2Code.def` which merely declares `Code` and `CodeBlock`.
